title: Redash console is reachable without authentication
description: The Redash console is served without authentication. Redash keeps the credentials of every connected data source server-side, so its UI is a front door to all of them at once.
remediation: Enforce Redash authentication (or its SSO integration), and keep the instance on the internal network.
limitation: One response body. The rule recognises the Redash console shell from its document title; it does not attempt a login, so it shows that the interface is served, not which data the caller could read.

observation.body: <html><head><title>Sign in · Redash</title></head><body><form method="post" action="/login"><input name="user"><input type="password" name="pass"><button>Sign in</button></form></body></html>
